pairs.why: B's slightly darker, felt-like brown with softer highlights is closer to the real cards' soft finish, while A's crown has a smoother, more plastic sheen that heads toward the 'statue' look.
Both hats have nearly the same shape, colour and soft clay-like shading, and neither one is clearly closer to the real cards.
A's shading is cleaner and smoother, like the bugle and bottle, while B's darker, grainier felt edges toward the 'too much texture' look the lessons reject.
A's warm orange with soft, even light fits the real cards' bright, smooth finish better than B's slightly muddier, more contrasty brown.
The two hats are almost the same in build, hatband and lighting, and I can't separate them with any confidence.
A's brighter, cleaner surface fits the real cards' polished but not glossy finish, while B's darker shading and faint surface grain look slightly more textured.
A is a little smoother and brighter, closer to the real cards, but the difference from B is very small.
B's slightly deeper colour and softer felt shading read a little less like plastic than A's brighter, more rubbery sheen, but the gap is minimal.
